definitions.explanation: A seat that has been specifically assigned or reserved, as opposed to a free/unreserved seat. Common on trains, at events, and in theaters.

examples.japanese: {指定席|していせき}を{予約|よやく}した。
{新幹線|しんかんせん}の{指定席|していせき}は{追加料金|ついかりょうきん}がかかる。
examples.english: Reserved seats on the Shinkansen cost extra.

examples.japanese: {指定席|していせき}は{満席|まんせき}だった。
examples.english: The reserved seats were fully booked.

notes:
USAGE: Common on trains (especially Shinkansen), at concerts, theaters, and sporting events.

CONTRAST:
・{指定席|していせき} (reserved seat)
・{自由席|じゆうせき} (unreserved/free seating)
・{立|た}ち{席|せき} (standing room)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{指定席|していせき}を{取|と}る (to get a reserved seat)
・{指定席|していせき}{券|けん} (reserved seat ticket)
・{指定席|していせき}{車両|しゃりょう} (reserved seat car)
